head: Calendaria shows your whole year as one scrolling calendar list
dek: Calendaria lays out your calendar from January to December as one continuous list, with the days that matter standing out and their main event next to the date. It was #39 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
means: If you plan months ahead, you can see the whole year at a glance.
todo: Find Calendaria in the App Store.
